name: Sales Proposal
description: Produces a client-facing sales proposal with executive summary, solution overview, ROI calculation, investment details, and next steps using proposal structure methodology. Use when the user asks to create a sales proposal, write a client proposal, build a deal proposal, draft a solution proposal for a prospect, or prepare a formal offer document. Do NOT use for investor pitch decks (use startup-pitch-narrative), internal business cases (use business-plan), or RFP responses (requires specialized procurement format).
